rule: every counted row is a CONSERVATIVE PATH UPPER BOUND on executed instructions per call; every instruction in the span counts, INCLUDING operand-free instructions (ret, and the stp frame); branch targets matched for Darwin LBB and ELF .L; loop-bearing symbols body x trip + remainder
counting_convention: an instruction is any line whose first token is an opcode with or without operands; `.` directives excluded; the rule is applied identically to every span, so _v15r_reset_hist is 16 (15 + ret)

_fmul.method: acyclic: static length bounds every path

_v15o_label.method: acyclic: static length bounds every path

_rmont.method: acyclic: static length bounds every path

_v15o_report.method: acyclic: static length bounds every path

_v15r_action.method: acyclic: static length bounds every path

_v15r_reset_hist.method: acyclic: static length bounds every path

scalar_detector: the counted TU is rebuilt with -mgeneral-regs-only, which removes the NEON register file from the compiler's model entirely (no q/d/v/s/h/b register can be allocated and no ASIMD-only instruction can be emitted); the register-class scan above ships zero matches, so this is a compiler guarantee, not a flag assertion
